seo.title: Amoxicillin: Uses, Dosage, Side Effects | Doctors Hub
seo.description: Complete guide to Amoxicillin (Amoxicillin). Learn uses, dosage, side effects, warnings, and drug interactions.

composition: Amoxicillin — consult product label for exact strength and excipients.
uses: Bacterial infections such as respiratory tract infections, otitis media, and urinary tract infections
Skin and soft tissue bacterial infections when prescribed by a doctor
howItWorks: Amoxicillin is a penicillin-type antibiotic. It works by inhibiting bacterial cell wall synthesis, which stops bacteria from multiplying. It is effective against many gram-positive and some gram-negative organisms.

dosage.adults: As directed by physician. Typical adult dose varies by condition and formulation.
dosage.children: Pediatric dosing must be weight-based. Consult pediatrician.
dosage.elderly: May require dose adjustment in elderly patients.
dosage.notes: Take with food if stomach upset occurs unless otherwise directed.

missedDose: Take as soon as remembered unless near next dose. Do not double dose.
overdose: Seek immediate medical attention. Contact nearest hospital or poison control.
warnings: Common Indian brands include Mox and Novamox. Available only on prescription in India.

pregnancy: Consult doctor before use during pregnancy. Risk-benefit assessment required.
breastfeeding: Consult doctor. Some medicines pass into breast milk.
kidneyDisease: Dose adjustment may be needed. Inform your nephrologist.
liverDisease: Use with caution. Liver function monitoring may be required.
driving: Avoid driving if dizziness or drowsiness occurs.
alcohol: Avoid alcohol unless approved by doctor. May increase side effects.
foodInteraction: Take as directed with or without food per physician advice.
drugInteractions: Oral contraceptives (may reduce efficacy — use backup contraception)
storage: Store in cool, dry place below 25°C. Keep away from children.

faqs.question: Is amoxicillin used for fever or pain?
faqs.answer: No. Amoxicillin treats bacterial infections. It does not reduce fever or pain like paracetamol.

faqs.question: Can I stop amoxicillin when I feel better?
faqs.answer: Complete the full course as prescribed unless your doctor advises otherwise. Stopping early can cause relapse and antibiotic resistance.
